requirements.summary: The backup directory contained one archive, which was selected and validated. The restored config.json was valid JSON and exactly matched the archive member by SHA-256 and direct comparison, including after restart.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the other current inventory files.
requirements.summary: Before restoration, current.txt was the only other file in the inventory directory. Its SHA-256 remained unchanged after restoration and after node restart.

Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
